theorems.name: Submission.smr_ufd_unit_coord_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (J : Covector (Eucl P) k ≃ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), (∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖J α‖) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, Measurable (fun x => v x α)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 ∧ v x α = 1) → ∃ u : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Measurable u ∧ (∀ x, ‖u x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖u x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), v x α = inner ℝ (J α) (u x)
